title: Well-posedness and numerical reconstruction of a source term for linear parabolic problems with an integral constraint
summary: This work investigates a time-dependent source identification problem for linear parabolic equations subject to an integral constraint and Neumann boundary conditions in a domain of $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\ge 1$. We establish well-posedness and higher regularity of the solution pair in parabolic Hölder spaces. A numerical algorithm based on a finite element discretization in space and an implicit time-stepping scheme is then developed for the reconstruction of the unknown source.
